title: Madam Grissel Steevens
html_source:
Dr. Richard and Grissel Steevens, brother and sister, founders of the hospital bearing their name, were born in England the latter part of the 17th century…It was very generally believed amongst the poor that Madame Steevens had the face of a pig; to dissapate which absurd idea she was accustomed to sit in one of the corridors of the hospital with her veil up, for some hours each week.
